from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split at the uniform line whose removal leaves matching panel sizes.
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and r == h-r-1]
    if row_seps:
        i = row_seps[0]
        a, b = grid[:i], grid[i+1:]
    else:
        col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and c == w-c-1]
        i = col_seps[0]
        a = [row[:i] for row in grid]
        b = [row[i+1:] for row in grid]
    ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row)
    cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row)
    shared = set(ca) & set(cb)
    # The panels share one color: retain it as the output ground and highlight
    # positions where that shared color occurs in both corresponding cells.
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(len(a))]
